name: add-alternate-marc-input-format-via-shared-read-edition
negative_constraints: Do not copy the find_* call sequence into the XML module. Always route through the shared read_edition so both formats stay in sync.
Do not change any find_* extractor to know about XML. Adapt the record object instead.
Do not silently change skip semantics during the refactor. Every former `continue` must become `return False`, and the edition is yielded only on True.
Do not drop the KeyboardInterrupt re-raise or the bad_data handling in parser().
Do not leave dead variables such as curr_loc or the commented-out find_subject_place/find_subject_time calls in the extracted function.
procedure: Locate the binary-MARC parser in catalog/marc/parse.py. Its parser() loop calls the find_* extractors inline on each record.
Move the per-record field extraction out of the loop into a reusable function, read_edition(r, edition). It returns True when the edition is valid and False when the record should be skipped.
Convert each skip from `continue` to `return False`. This covers duplicate 001 fields, a missing title, and duplicate 008 fields.
Keep the find_* call order unchanged inside read_edition. Keep the 008 slicing unchanged: publish_date [7:11], publish_country [15:18], languages ['ISO:'+[35:38]].

Reduce parser() to building the edition dict with source_record_loc, then calling `if read_edition(r, edition): yield edition`. Keep the existing try/except: KeyboardInterrupt re-raises and other errors go to bad_data.
Create the new-format module, catalog/marc/parse_xml.py. Import read_edition from parse.py.

In the new module, write adapter classes that wrap the format and expose the record interface the find_* functions already use: get_fields(tag), get_field(tag), str() of control fields, subfield contents, subfield_sequence, indicator1 and indicator2.
For MARC XML, match on namespaced tags: {http://www.loc.gov/MARC21/slim}datafield, controlfield and subfield.

In the datafield adapter, build contents as a dict mapping each subfield code to a list of values, and keep the ordered (code, text) pairs in subfield_sequence. Read ind1 and ind2 from the element's attributes. Treat empty subfield text (None) as ''.
validation: Run the existing MARC parse tests or sample files. Confirm the binary parser yields the same editions before and after the refactor.
Parse a sample MARC XML record with an ElementTree root. Confirm the title, authors, ISBN and 008-derived fields match the binary output for the same record.
Check that records with an empty subfield or a missing title are handled without exceptions.

name: add-missing-solr-field-to-fl-list
negative_constraints: Do not change the Solr schema or reindex when the field is already stored. The bug is that the query omits it.
Do not swap the explicit fl list for fl=* or drop fields. That inflates the payload and can break facets or performance.
Do not add URL-encoding or spaces inside the fl value. It is a raw comma list inside a %-formatted string.
Do not alter the %-format placeholders (q, offset, rows) or their argument tuple.
Do not add a client-side fallback lookup for covers instead of requesting the field.
procedure: Find the template or downstream code reading the field that comes back empty, e.g. cover_edition_key used to render covers on subject pages.
In openlibrary/plugins/worksearch/code.py, find the solr_select URL string for that endpoint (the subjects class GET handler) and read its fl=key,author_name,... parameter.

Confirm the field exists in the Solr schema and is already requested elsewhere in worksearch, for example in the main search fl list. Reusing an existing stored field means no indexing change is needed.
Append the field name to the comma-separated fl list in place: no spaces, keep the existing order, add at the end.
Grep the same file for other hand-built solr_select/fl strings that serve the same consumer. Add the field to those too if the consumer depends on it.
Leave the q, fq, sort, facet and wt params alone. Change only fl.
validation: Run the existing worksearch tests (pytest openlibrary/plugins/worksearch) to make sure nothing regresses.
Load a /subjects/<key> page against dev Solr and check that the JSON docs contain cover_edition_key and that covers render.
Check that the format string still has a matching number of % placeholders, e.g. with python -c import or a lint pass on code.py.

name: align-consumer-keys-with-producer-schema
negative_constraints: 不要为了让测试通过而修改 fixture 却不改逻辑, 反之亦然。
不要扩大改动范围到命名风格重构。
procedure: 当消费端 (比较/合并逻辑) 读取的键与生产端输出不一致时, 先定位生产端的规范键名。
列出消费端对该键的所有读取点, 以及同模块内用来模拟生产端输出的测试数据。
在一次提交中同时修改读取点和 fixture, 使 fixture 反映真实生产端输出。
validation: run existing tests
grep 旧键名, 确认在受影响模块内为零。

name: align-marc-parse-field-cardinality-with-edition-schema
negative_constraints: 不要输出 schema 中不存在的复数键(如 subtitles、by_statements),也不要使用 edition 这样的歧义键。
不要把 schema 要求为列表的字段写成裸字符串,也不要把单值字段写成 list。
不要在合并子字段前省略对 ISBD 标点(' /,;:')的清理。
procedure: 定位 catalog/marc/parse.py 中写入 edition dict 的 find_* 函数(find_title, find_edition, find_lccn 等)。
对照 edition schema 核对每个输出键的名称和单值/多值属性。Open Library 的 schema 中 subtitle、by_statement、edition_name 是单值字符串,lccn 是列表。
单值字段使用单数键名,并把多个 MARC 子字段合并成一个字符串。subtitle 用 ' : '.join,join 前先对每个值做 strip(' /,;:')。by_statement 用 ' '.join。edition_name 用 ' '.join。
多值字段的结果要包成 list,即使只取到一个匹配也一样,例如 edition['lccn'] = [m.group(1)]。
检查下游读取这些键的代码(import/load、合并逻辑),确认键名重命名(subtitles→subtitle、by_statements→by_statement、edition→edition_name)后没有残留引用旧键。
validation: 运行现有的 MARC 解析测试(catalog/marc 下的测试或 sample record),确认通过。
用含多个 245$b/$c 和 010 的样例 MARC 记录解析,断言 subtitle/by_statement 为 str、lccn 为 list。
grep 全仓确认旧键 subtitles、by_statements、edition 没有残留引用。

name: align-marc-parser-edition-keys-to-schema
negative_constraints: 不要在没有核对 schema 的情况下凭猜测改名。
不要改变子字段 ('a'、'z') 的遍历方式和正则匹配逻辑。
不要为空列表写入 key。
不要新旧两个 key 同时写入作为兼容层, 除非下游明确需要。
不要把 ISBN-10 和 ISBN-13 混在同一个列表里。
procedure: 定位 catalog/marc/parse.py 中写入 edition dict 的 find_* 函数, 例如 find_dewey_number、find_isbn、find_lccn、find_lc_classification。
把每个 edition["..."] 的 key 与 edition schema/type 定义里的权威字段名逐一对照。例如 dewey_number 应为 dewey_decimal_class, lccn 应为 LCCN。只修改 key 名, 不改提取逻辑。
沿用现有大小写约定: 缩写类字段用全大写, 如 LCCN、LC_classification、ISBN_10、ISBN_13。
如果 schema 把一个字段拆成多个类型化字段 (例如 ISBN 拆为 ISBN_10 和 ISBN_13), 就在提取循环里按值的特征分桶。例如按 re_isbn 匹配结果 m.group(1) 的长度判断: 13 位归入 ISBN_13, 其余归入 ISBN_10。
每个分桶各自做非空判断, 非空时才写入 edition, 与原来 'if isbn:' 的行为保持一致。
在仓库中 grep 旧 key 名 (dewey_number、'ISBN'、'lccn'), 确认没有下游消费者依赖旧名。如果有, 一并更新。
validation: run existing tests
用一条含 020 (同时有 10 位和 13 位 ISBN)、010、082 字段的 MARC 样例跑 parser, 断言输出包含 ISBN_10、ISBN_13、LCCN、dewey_decimal_class, 且不再出现旧 key。
grep 确认仓库中不再有对旧 key 名的引用。

name: align-parser-output-keys-with-schema
negative_constraints: 不要只改函数名而保留旧 key,数据层面的修复才是这次的目的。
不要在没有 schema 依据的情况下自行发明新字段名。
procedure: 确认 schema 规定的规范字段名,来源可以是 type 定义或现有导入代码里的用法。
定位产出该字段的 parser 函数,修改字典赋值语句里的 key。
让生产函数的命名与 key 保持一致,并同步更新所有调用点。
搜索旧 key 在下游(导入、显示、合并逻辑)的读取处,一并迁移。
validation: 用样例输入跑 parser,检查输出字典里的 key 符合 schema。
全仓 grep 旧 key,确认结果为零或仅剩有意保留的引用。

name: amazon-marc-merge-multi-publisher-list
negative_constraints: 不要用 assert 强制 Amazon 只有一个出版商，真实记录中存在多个出版商。
不要把 mismatch 的 return 放在外层循环内部。那样只会比较第一个 amazon 出版商，多出版商支持等于失效。原始 diff 的缩进就存在这个风险，需要复核。
不要改变匹配分值或 reason 字符串，level2_merge 和 attempt_merge 的阈值依赖这些分值。
不要只改 build_amazon 而遗漏 compare_publisher 中的 key 名，否则会静默落入 'either missing' 分支，得 0 分。
procedure: 在 catalog/merge/amazon.py 中定位 build_amazon。删除 `assert len(edition['publishers']) == 1`。把完整列表保存到 amazon['publishers']，不要只取单值 amazon['publisher']。
统一 key 的命名：amazon 侧和 marc 侧都用复数 'publishers'，值为 list。用 grep 搜索 amazon['publisher'] 和 'publisher' in amazon，确认没有残留的单数读取点。

改写 compare_publisher。条件改为 `'publishers' in amazon and 'publishers' in marc`。用双层循环遍历 amazon_pub × marc_pub。循环体内复用原有匹配阶梯，顺序不变：normalize 后相等 → substr_match → 去空格后 substr_match → short_part_publisher_match。命中任一项立即返回原有的 (field, reason, score) 元组，分值不变（match 和 occur within the other 都是 100）。
把 mismatch 返回 ('publisher','mismatch',-25) 放在外层循环结束之后，保证所有组合都比较过再判定不匹配。
保留 either-missing 分支 ('publisher','either missing',0)，并把判断条件同步改成复数 key。
同步更新文件内的 test_merge* fixture：amazon dict 中的 'publisher': u'X' 改为 'publishers': [u'X']。
validation: 运行 amazon.py 内的 test_merge、test_merge2 等函数（例如 `python -c 'import catalog.merge.amazon as a; a.test_merge(); a.test_merge2()'` 或 py.test），确认 attempt_merge 在阈值 735 下仍返回 True。
手工构造用例：amazon publishers=['Foo','Collins']、marc publishers=['Collins']，应得到 match 100。
手工构造用例：两侧都没有共同出版商时，应得到 mismatch -25。
缺少任一侧时应得到 either missing 0。

name: anchor-marc-spec-term-regexes
negative_constraints: 不要在不加 '$' 的情况下用 re.match 判断整串语法, 否则部分匹配会掩盖畸形 spec。
不要对未知 procedure 或畸形 subfield spec 只发 warn 后返回 null_generator, 静默丢值会让 schema 错误难以发现。
不要在 term 层用 \S+ 或数字前缀等启发式猜测类型, 分类应以精确正则匹配为准, 其余一律视为 procedure。
不要把调试用的 warn(field_generator/separate/subfields_exact 输出) 留在提交代码里, 那是临时诊断噪音。
不要指望 literal 内含空格能工作。term 由 \s+ 切分, 这个限制要在注释里写明, 不要假装支持。
procedure: 定位 catalog/marc/parse.py 中的 term 正则 (re_literal, re_field) 和 subfield 正则 (re_subfields_exact, re_subfields_range, re_positions)。
在每个用 re.match 做整项分类的正则末尾加 '$' 锚点。re.match 只锚定开头, 不加 '$' 时 'abc-d' 这类 spec 会被 [a-z]+ 部分匹配, 错误地按 exact 处理。
把 re_field 的捕获从 (\S+) 放宽为 (.*)$, 让 'NNN:' 后的整段 subfield spec 交给 field_generator 解析; term 层只负责切分和分发。
删除基于前缀猜测的 re_procedure。凡是不匹配 literal 或 field 的 term, 一律当作 procedure 名查表; 查不到就调用 spec_die 报错。

新增 subfield 语法时 (例如 'a*' 表示逐个产出该 subfield 的每次出现), 先加一个带 '$' 锚点的正则 (re_subfield_separate = r'([a-z])\*$')。再在 field_generator 内实现对应的闭包 generator: 遍历 r.get_fields(fieldname), 对每个字段的 f.get_elts(name) 逐个 yield。最后在非控制字段分支中按顺序加入匹配判断。
错误路径统一使用带上下文的 die helper。spec 级用 spec_die, 字段级用 subfield_die, 消息带 'schema:' 前缀以及字段名和 subfield spec。用它们替换 warn 加 null_generator 的静默降级。
检查控制字段字符区间的边界断言: 单字符区间 (如 008:5-5) 合法, 断言应为 start <= end, 不要用 start < end。
validation: 编译含 '245:a', '245:abc', '245:a-c', '650:a*', '008:5-5', '008:0-3' 的 spec, 确认分别走 exact、range、separate 和控制字段区间分支。
确认 '245:a-cx'、'245:A'、'008:abc' 会触发带 'schema:' 前缀的 die, 不再被部分匹配或静默忽略。
确认未知 procedure 名会让 compile_marc_spec 报错退出。
对一条含重复 650$a 的 MARC 记录运行 '650:a*', 确认每次出现都单独产出一个值。
如有现有导入或解析脚本, 端到端跑一遍, 确认原有 spec 输出不变。

name: annotate-catalog-schema-with-marc-source-fields
negative_constraints: 不要修改字段名、类型或 count 语义。本任务只做注解,不改数据模型。
不要为没有明确 MARC 来源的字段(如 sort_title、source_record_loc、source_record_id)臆造 marc_fields。
不要把不确定的映射作为生效值写入。应写成注释,并记入 questions 块。
不要在同一个 dict 内混用 tab 和空格缩进。
不要顺带改动 MARC 解析或导入代码,改动范围限定在 schema 描述文件。
procedure: 定位 catalog/schema.py 中的 `schema` dict。它的 key 是类型名(如 'author'、'edition'),value 是由 (field_name, attrs_dict) 元组组成的有序列表。
只为能直接对应到 MARC tag/subfield 的字段补充元数据。在 attrs dict 中增加 'marc_fields' 键,值采用 'TAG:subfieldcodes' 格式字符串,例如 title→'245:ab'、by_statement→'245:c'、contributions→'700:abcde'。
一个字段对应多个 MARC 来源时,把 'marc_fields' 写成列表,例如 ['100:abcd', '110:ab', '710:ab', '111:acdn', '711:acdn']。
映射有疑问时,把该行 'marc_fields' 写成注释(`# 'marc_fields': [...]`),不要把它作为生效值。同时在文件顶部的 `### questions` 注释块里记录待确认的问题,例如机构是否算 author、'a-z*' 的含义。
加注解的字段,把单行 dict 展开为多行,每个键占一行。键的顺序保持为 type、count、marc_fields、example、description,便于 diff 审阅。
保持原有的 'type'、'count'、'example'、'description' 取值不变,字段在列表中的顺序也不变。这份 schema 会被脚本用来生成 HTML 表示,顺序就是输出顺序。
缩进统一使用空格。修改时顺手把原有的 tab 缩进改成空格,避免混用。
validation: 运行 `python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('catalog/schema.py').read())"`,确认语法正确。
运行 `python catalog/schema.py`,确认仍能生成 HTML 表示且无异常。
逐个检查新增的 marc_fields 值:要么是 'NNN:codes' 格式的字符串,要么是由这类字符串组成的列表。
对比修改前后的字段列表,确认字段名和顺序没有变化。
运行现有测试(如存在),确认没有 import 层面的回归。

name: batch-destructive-step-after-success-guard
negative_constraints: Do not run the cleanup or delete step when the transfer step has raised.
Do not wrap the whole loop in a single try. That still aborts all remaining items on the first error.
Do not mark an item as archived or processed before its transfer has succeeded.
procedure: Identify loops that copy or move data and then delete the source, e.g. archive or migration scripts in coverstore.
Order each iteration as transfer first, then the destructive cleanup. Put both in one per-item try block.
On exception, report the item key and the traceback, and continue with the next item.
Leave unfinished items in a state the next run can pick up again. For example, keep archived=false and keep the local file so a later run retries them.
validation: Simulate a failure on the Nth item.
Verify that items after N are processed.
Verify that item N's source data is intact and still eligible for a retry run.

name: batch-prefetch-coverstore-ids-into-request-cache
negative_constraints: Do not store the cache in a module-level or global variable. Keep it in web.ctx so it is scoped to one request and cannot leak between requests or go stale.
Do not let a prefetch failure break the page. Catch IOError and silently fall back to per-item queries.
Do not serve cached values for queries that carry extra kwargs beyond olid. Only the exact single-key shape is safe.
Do not change the return shape of query_coverstore. Callers expect a list of ids.
Do not cache only the olids that have covers. Record [] for the misses too, otherwise each miss still triggers an HTTP request.
procedure: Locate the per-item remote call that runs once per edition while the work page renders: query_coverstore(category, **kw) in openlibrary/plugins/upstream/models.py.
Locate where the full edition list is known ahead of time. Here that is Work.get_editions, which reads edition_key from the search result before calling web.ctx.site.get_many.
Add a batch helper, populate_coverstore_cache(olids). It calls the coverstore's multi-id endpoint once (<coverstore>/b/query?cmd=ids&olid=a,b,c).

In that helper, build a dict keyed by olid. Each value must match the shape query_coverstore normally returns: a list such as [id], or [] when the olid has no cover. Store the dict on the request-scoped web.ctx (web.ctx.coverstore_cache).

In query_coverstore, add a fast path that runs only when the kwargs are exactly olid. It returns web.ctx['coverstore_cache'][olid]. On KeyError, which covers both a missing cache and a missing olid, fall through to the original HTTP query.
Call the prefetch helper just before the bulk get_many of editions, so that later Edition cover lookups hit the cache.
validation: Run the existing tests for the upstream models.
Load a work page with many editions and confirm the coverstore receives one batched cmd=ids request instead of one request per edition.
Confirm that covers render the same as before, and that editions without covers still show the placeholder.
Simulate coverstore being unavailable and confirm the page still renders.

name: binary-record-parser-bounded-repair-negative-constraints
negative_constraints: 不要为了让脏数据通过,而把断言改成 try/except 吞掉异常,或改成静默跳过该字段。
不要引入无上限的容错扫描,否则会掩盖真正损坏的记录。
不要把修正逻辑放到切片之后再补救,必须在计算切片之前完成修正。
procedure: 定位按 directory 或 offset 切片解析定长或分隔记录的代码路径,先找出切片两端各自应当落在哪个分隔符上。
在切片前分别对起点和终点做局部校验。发现不符时,只尝试已知的、有界的修正(这里是 +1),并用断言确认修正后的位置确实是分隔符。
先修正 offset,再基于新的 offset 校验 length,保证两次修正有正确的依赖顺序。
保留原有的最终一致性断言,作为防御的最后一道。
validation: 运行现有解析器测试。
对比修复前后在正常样本上的输出是否完全一致。
对偏 1 的样本验证可以恢复,对偏移更大的样本验证会失败。

name: build-marc-merge-pool-index-maps
negative_constraints: 不要在多个 archive 之间复用同一个索引 map 实例,必须每个 archive 重新初始化。
不要把未经 normalize 和截断的原始标题作为 key,否则会导致合并匹配失效。
不要把 LCCN 字段中的 '???' 等占位值写入 lccn_map。
不要在 map 中存 loc 字符串。必须存全局递增的 loc_num,并依赖 loc_map 做回查。
不要因为单条记录的 245 指示符不是数字而中断整个构建,应捕获 ValueError 后继续处理。
procedure: 先确认新脚本放在 catalog/merge/ 目录下,与现有 merge 代码在一起。入口是一个独立的 Python 2.5 脚本,形式和 build_db.py 一样。
用一个 archive 元组列表 (archive_id, 显示名, 记录总数) 描述数据源。按记录总数升序遍历,每个 archive 都重新创建 defaultdict(list) 作为各个索引 map,避免不同 archive 的索引互相污染。
输入每行是一条记录,结构为 (loc_str, tags),其中每个 tag 是 (tag, ind, subtags)。处理每条记录时,先把全局 loc_num 加 1,再向 d/loc_map 写一行 'loc_num loc_str'。之后各个 map 里只存这个整数 loc,不存原始位置字符串。
按 MARC 字段分别提取键:
010 字段提取 LCCN:跳过全是问号的值,然后用 re_lccn 取前缀和数字部分。
020 字段提取 ISBN:用 re_isbn 取 group(1),去掉括号里的卷号等限定信息。
035 字段提取 OCLC:只匹配带 (OCoLC) 前缀的值,并去掉数字前面的 0。
245 字段提取标题:用 subfield a 生成标题,用 a+b 生成标题加副标题。第二指示符 ind[1] 是非排序前缀长度,值不为 0 时再追加去掉前缀的变体;int 转换失败时忽略该变体。
标题键统一走 normalize():去掉非 \w 和空格的字符,把连续空白合并成一个空格,转小写,最后截取前 25 个字符。
每个 archive 处理完后用 write_map 写出 d/<archive_id>_<name> 文本文件。每行格式是 key\t后接空格分隔的 loc 列表。
处理过程中每 10000 条打印一次进度和速率。可以参考 grand_total 估算总体进度。
validation: 用一个小型样例输入文件运行脚本,检查 d/loc_map 的行号是否连续且唯一。
检查 d/<archive>_isbn 等输出文件的每一行是否都是 key\tint int ... 的格式。
对已知记录核对 ISBN 是否去掉了括号限定、OCLC 是否去掉了前导 0、标题键是否为小写且不超过 25 个字符。
确认运行进度输出正常,且 eval 解析每一行时没有异常。

name: bulkimport-comprehension-and-contract-pitfalls
negative_constraints: Do not change the order of the transaction, thing, version and data inserts.
Do not implement reindex or bulk_update as a side effect of a bugfix.
procedure: When reviewing or fixing openlibrary/utils/bulkimport.py, check that every list comprehension's iteration variable matches the name used in its expression. Under Python 2 a leaked variable hides this bug.

Compare the docstring promises with the code. For example, the docstring says created and last_modified are added to records, so check they are actually added to the data JSON, not only to the thing table.
Confirm the incr_seq arithmetic: end = setval result + 1, and begin = end - n.
Make the smallest possible code-only fix and keep the existing function signatures.
validation: Run existing tests.
Run bulk_new on distinct docs and check that the return value equals [d['key'] for d in docs].
Run py_compile or pyflakes on the module to catch undefined or shadowed names.

name: canonicalize-subject-urls-lowercase-redirect
negative_constraints: Do not lowercase silently and serve the content at the mixed-case URL. Redirect so there is one canonical URL.
Do not prepend '/subjects/' again after switching the path regex to capture the full key, or the prefix will be doubled.
Do not change the underscore/space normalization inside get_subject as part of this fix.
procedure: Locate the subject page/JSON handlers in openlibrary/plugins/worksearch/code.py: the delegate.page classes whose path matches /subjects/....
Change the path regex so the full key is captured, e.g. '(/subjects/.+)' instead of '/subjects/(.+)'. GET then receives the complete key and does not rebuild it from a prefix.
At the top of GET, compare key.lower() with key. If they differ, raise web.seeother(key.lower()) to redirect to the lowercase canonical URL before any solr or DB lookup runs.
Apply the same redirect to sibling subject handlers (HTML page and .json variants) so all entry points use one canonical form.
Continue to use the existing get_subject(key, ...) / SUBJECTS prefix table for lookups. Do not reintroduce per-handler key parsing.
validation: Request /subjects/Love.json and confirm a 303 redirect to /subjects/love.json.
Request /subjects/love.json and confirm a 200 response with no redirect loop.
Check that the prefixed subject types (/subjects/place:..., person:..., time:...) still resolve after the path regex change.
Run the existing worksearch tests.

name: catalog-find-other-editions-by-author-name-match
negative_constraints: 不要自己写名字比较逻辑。必须复用 match_name，并显式传入 last_name_only_ok=True。
不要漏掉对已关联当前 work 的 edition 和同一作者 key 的过滤，否则输出会被自身结果淹没。
不要直接访问生产库，必须先 set_staging(True)。
不要在没有 'authors' 或 'title' 的记录上直接取下标。一律用 e.get(...) 做防御判断。
不要在这类诊断脚本里写回或合并数据。它只负责发现候选，不做修复。
procedure: 在 catalog/works/ 下新建独立的 python2 脚本。不要修改 merge 核心模块。脚本开头沿用仓库惯例：先用 codecs.getwriter('utf-8') 包装 sys.stdout，再调用 set_staging(True)，确保读的是 staging 数据。
查询数据时复用 catalog.utils.query 里的 query_iter，用来分页遍历 /type/work 和 /type/edition。需要取哪些字段，就在查询字典里把这些键设为 None（例如 key、title、authors、works、title_prefix）。
对每个 work，先用 {'type':'/type/edition','works':wkey} 查出它已关联的 editions。title 为空的 edition 跳过。把 get_title(e) 和 e['title'] 都加入一个标题集合，这样带 title_prefix 的变体也能覆盖到。
以 w['authors'][0]['key'] 作为 work 的主作者，用 withKey 取出完整的作者记录。
对集合里的每个标题，按 title 精确查询 editions，并依次过滤：没有 authors 的跳过；已关联到当前 work 的跳过；作者 key 与 work 作者相同的跳过。剩下的候选，逐个用 withKey 取出它的作者。
用 catalog.merge.names.match_name(name, work_author['name'], last_name_only_ok=True) 判断两个作者名是否相似。匹配上的 (edition, author) 对就是候选结果：它可能是重复作者，也可能是同一作品的另一版本。
输出时复用 catalog.utils.fmt_author 来格式化作者。按 work 分组打印 work 本身、标题集合、work 作者，以及每个候选的作者 key 和 edition。没有候选的 work 不打印。
validation: 运行 python2 -m py_compile catalog/works/find_other_editions.py，确认语法正确。
在 staging 上运行脚本，抽查几个 work。确认输出不包含已关联当前 work 的 edition，也不包含同一作者 key 的记录，并且中文等非 ASCII 名称能正常输出。
确认导入路径 catalog.merge.names、catalog.utils、catalog.utils.query 都能成功导入。

name: catalog-merge-inline-test-coverage
negative_constraints: 不要为了让测试通过去修改 compare_title 或 compare_authors 的分数和原因字符串;测试应锁定现有行为。
不要把阈值断言写成精确相等,除非确实要锁定评分权重。
不要省略 build_titles 这一步,直接比较原始 dict 会让 compare_title 缺少它需要的字段。
不要用 Python 3 语法;本代码库是 Python 2,使用 print 语句、unicode() 和 u'' 字面量。
procedure: 先定位 catalog/merge/merge.py,确认这次要覆盖的是哪个合并步骤: build_titles、compare_title、compare_authors、level1_merge 还是 level2_merge。
按该模块的现有约定写测试: 在 merge.py 末尾添加模块级 test_* 函数(nose/py.test 风格),不要另建测试框架。
如果测试需要的输入在代码里还没有现成的整理函数,先补一个小的纯函数。例如 full_title(edition) 用 ' : ' 把 title 和可选的 subtitle 拼起来。然后为它写一个直接测试,至少覆盖带 subtitle 和不带 subtitle 两种情况。
构造真实的 amazon/marc 记录对作为 fixture。amazon 的 authors 用 (name, role) 元组列表;marc 的 authors 用带 db_name/personal_name 的 dict 列表;marc 的 publisher 和 ISBN_10 是列表;unicode 字段要和真实导入的数据形态一致。
标题比较测试: 两边都先经过 build_titles(unicode(...)) 再比较。先断言 short_title 相等,再断言 compare_title 返回的完整三元组 (类别, 原因字符串, 分数)。原因字符串要按现有代码逐字复制,包括拼写错误,例如 'containted within other title'。
整体合并测试: 用 sum(i[2] for i in score) 汇总 level1_merge 或 level2_merge 的分数,然后对合并阈值做断言,例如 total > 735,确认这对记录确实会被判定为匹配。
validation: 在 catalog/merge 目录下运行 nosetests merge.py 或 py.test merge.py,确认新增的 test_* 函数被收集到并且通过。
检查 level1_merge 加上 level2_merge 的总分确实跨过了阈值。可以临时打印 score,但如果要长期保留这些 print,需要确认它不会污染输出。

name: catalog-record-merge-scoring
negative_constraints: 不要在 compare_authors 里重复写 find_marc_author_field 的循环, 直接调用 helper 即可。
不要写 `except ValueError, TypeError:`。在 Python 2 里它只会捕获 ValueError, 并把异常绑定到名字 TypeError 上。要用 `except (ValueError, TypeError):`。
不要用裸 except 加 print 来调试日期解析。年份提取失败时应该显式返回 mismatch 或 missing。
不要直接比较原始标题。比较前要先经过 normalize().lower() 和变体展开。
不要混用 dict key 的命名风格。现有代码里同时出现了 'full-title' 和 'full_title', 新代码要统一用 build_titles 产出的下划线形式。
不要对少于 9 个字符的标题给出完全匹配的高分。
procedure: 定位 catalog/merge/ 目录。新的合并/匹配逻辑放在 merge.py 中, 与同目录的 names.py(match_name)和 normalize.py(normalize)并列, 用相对导入方式复用这两个模块。
先把每条记录预处理成可比较的结构: 用 build_titles 生成 full_title、normalized_title(normalize 后再 lower)、titles 变体列表和 short_title(normalized_title 的前 25 个字符)。
titles 变体列表要覆盖以下几种: '&' 替换成 'and' 的版本; 去掉开头 'the '/'a ' 冠词的版本; 去掉 Amazon 标题末尾括号说明(re '^(.*) \([^)]+?\)$')的版本。
每个字段写一个 compare_* 函数, 统一返回 (field, reason, score) 三元组。field 和 reason 是字符串, score 是整数, 可正可负。
缺失值要单独处理。字段缺失或为空时返回中性分 0 或很小的惩罚(例如 'value missing'/0), 不能当作 mismatch 处理。
分层评分。level1_merge 只比较 short_title、日期和 ISBN_10, 用来快速筛选。完整比较再加上 compare_authors 和 compare_title(包括标题变体两两完全相等、子串匹配等规则)。
日期比较: 完全相等给高分。转成 int 后相差 ±2 年给小惩罚。其他情况视为 mismatch, 给大惩罚。int 转换出错时也走 mismatch 分支。
作者比较: 用 find_marc_author_field 按 person→org→event 的顺序找到 MARC 作者字段, 然后用 match_name 逐个比对 Amazon 作者。两边都没有作者、只有一边有作者、匹配、不匹配, 这四种情况分别给分。
validation: python -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "catalog/merge"); import merge' 能成功导入, 说明 names 和 normalize 的导入可以解析。
构造两条测试记录。完全相同时总分应为正且最高; ISBN 冲突或日期相差大于 2 年时, 总分应明显下降。
检查 build_titles('The Cat & Hat (Paperback)') 的输出, 应包含去掉冠词、'&' 换成 'and'、去掉括号这几种变体。
当 publish_date 为非数字字符串时, compare_date 应返回 mismatch, 不能抛出异常。

name: catalog-schema-marc-field-mapping-extension
negative_constraints: 不要在 parse.py 里硬编码新的标签处理逻辑，映射应通过 schema 的 marc_fields 声明完成。
不要编造子字段代码。新标签使用的子字段集合应符合 MARC21 对该标签的定义（如 630 的 a,c,d,e,g,n,p,q,s,t）。
不要修改字段的 'count'、'type' 或 'example'，除非任务明确要求。
procedure: 定位 catalog/schema.py 中的 schema_ordered，找到目标 OL 字段，例如 subjects 或 subject_times，以及它的 'marc_fields' 列表。
沿用已有的映射语法 'TAG:subfields--subdiv--subdiv'：'--x--v--y--z' 表示用 ' -- ' 连接的主题细分；'TAG:y*' 表示该子字段的所有重复值。
补上缺失的 MARC 标签，并按标签数字顺序插入。例如：统一题名主题 630 用 '630:acdegnpqst--v--x--y--z'；地理主题 651 的年代细分也应进入 subject_times，即 '651:y*'。
检查同类字段之间是否一致。subjects 已覆盖 600/610/630/650/651，那么 subject_times、subject_places 等派生字段也应覆盖对应的标签，避免同一条记录的信息只在部分字段中出现。
只改 schema 的声明。解析器从 marc_fields 自动生成 value generator，不需要改 parse.py。
validation: run existing tests
用含 630 和 651$y 的样例 MARC 记录跑 distill_record，确认 subjects 中出现 630 生成的主题串，subject_times 中出现 651$y 的值。
确认 schema 模块能正常导入，marc_fields 字符串能被映射解析器接受。

name: compile-marc-spec-to-field-producer
negative_constraints: Do not leave a placeholder producer that yields constant data. It silently fills every OL field with fake values.
Do not call list() on a possibly-None producer result without the guard.
Do not apply unicode normalization twice, once per element and again in a dict-level massage pass. Normalize once, at extraction time.
Do not raise on unrecognized multi-term specs unless the task requires it. The current contract is that None means skip.
Do not change the order of the Error message arguments without checking the format string. The existing message passes (field_name, locator) in an order that does not match its placeholders.
procedure: Locate compile_marc_spec and distill_record in catalog/marc/parse.py. Check whether the producer is still a stub, for example one that yields a constant 'VAL'.
Split the spec on whitespace with a module-level compiled regex (re_spaces = r'\s+').

Handle a single-term spec only when it matches the field:subfields form, i.e. re_codespec = r'(\d\d\d):([a-z]+)'. Take the three-digit tag as field and expand the subfield letters with list(m.group(2)).

Return a closure field_producer(field, subfields) that builds a generator(r). The generator iterates r.get_fields(field). For each field, join f.get_elts(sf) with spaces for every subfield, then join the per-subfield results with spaces. Yield one value per MARC field occurrence.
Run every subfield element through a single unicode_to_utf8 helper (normalize('NFKC', u).encode('utf8')) before yielding. This replaces the generic massage_value/massage_dict post-processing.

When compile_marc_spec cannot parse a spec, return None instead of raising. In distill_record, guard the call with field_values = (producer and list(producer(r))) or [] so unparseable specs produce no values.
Keep the existing semantics in distill_record. A single-valued field with more than one value raises Error. A multi-valued field stores the list. A single-valued field stores field_values[0].
Optionally, make the __main__ debug output easier to read by printing a blank line between records.
validation: Run python catalog/marc/parse.py <source_id> <file_locator> < sample.mrc. Confirm the editions show real subfield text, for example 245:ab giving the title, instead of 'VAL'.
Confirm that a repeatable tag such as 650 produces a list for multi-valued fields, and that a duplicate single-valued tag raises Error.
Confirm that a spec the parser does not understand yields no field and does not crash.
Confirm that the output strings are NFKC-normalized UTF-8 bytes.

name: consolidate-local-marc-reader-into-get-ia
negative_constraints: Do not drop the defensive ValueError and missing-file guards silently when replacing a helper whose callers treat a falsy return as 'skip'.
Do not concatenate a directory constant and a filename when the constant may lack a trailing separator.
Do not leave two marc_path constants pointing at different roots in different modules after consolidation.
Do not mix this refactor with changes to get_from_archive's HTTP Range logic.
procedure: Run grep across catalog/ for module-local helpers that parse a 'file:offset:length' MARC locator and read bytes, such as get_data in importer/merge.py.
Put a single canonical helper in catalog/get_ia.py, next to get_from_archive. Use the same unpacking style (file, offset, length = locator.split(':')) and a module-level marc_path constant.
Delete the duplicated helper and its module-local marc_path from the caller module (e.g. merge.py). Then switch every call site to the canonical name (get_data(mc) -> get_from_local(mc)).

Make sure the caller actually imports the new name. Use an explicit 'from catalog.get_ia import get_from_local' rather than relying on an existing wildcard import. Remove imports that are now unused (e.g. os, if it was only used by the deleted helper).

Keep the contract the callers depend on. merge.py does 'if not data: return True', so the old helper returned None for a malformed locator (ValueError) and for a missing file (os.path.exists). Either keep those guards inside get_from_local, or catch the failures at the call site.
Normalize path joining. Use os.path.join(marc_path, file), or make sure marc_path ends with '/'. The new constant '/1/edward/marc' has no trailing slash, while the old one '/2/pharos/marc/' did.
validation: Run python -c 'import catalog.importer.merge; import catalog.get_ia' (or the py2 equivalent) to confirm the imports resolve.
Grep confirms there are no remaining references to the deleted get_data in merge.py.
Call get_from_local with a valid locator and check it returns a buffer of the requested length.
Call it with a malformed locator and with a missing file, and check try_merge still returns cleanly instead of raising.

name: coverstore-add-root-index-route
negative_constraints: Do not change or reorder the existing cover, upload or query regexes. Cover URL parsing such as '-([SML]).jpg' must keep working unchanged.
Do not add a template system, static files or new dependencies for a one-line landing page.
Do not hard-code an internal or dev hostname in the link. Point it at the public docs URL.
Do not use a loose pattern such as '/.*' or '/(.*)' for the index route, because it would shadow the category routes.
procedure: Open coverstore/coverstore/code.py. Find the web.py `urls` tuple. It is a flat sequence of (regex, class-name) pairs.

Add the exact-match pattern '/' mapped to a new handler name, for example 'index'. Put it at the top of the tuple, before patterns like '/([^ /]*)/upload'. The existing patterns all have a category prefix. An exact '/' does not overlap them, but putting it first makes the intent clear.

Define the handler as a plain web.py class with a `GET(self)` method. Follow the style of the existing `upload`, `cover` and `query` classes. Place it next to those handlers, after the ERROR_* constants.

Return a small inline HTML string from GET. It should contain a heading such as 'Open Library Book Covers Repository' and an anchor to the public covers API docs (http://openlibrary.org/dev/docs/api/covers). No template is needed.
Keep the change limited to the code surface. Only the route entry and the handler class are required.
validation: Run the existing coverstore tests, if any, to confirm the cover, upload and query routes still resolve.
Start the coverstore web.py app locally and GET '/'. Expect HTTP 200 and HTML containing the covers API link.
GET an existing cover URL such as /b/id/1-S.jpg and confirm it still routes to the 'cover' handler and not to 'index'.

name: coverstore-archive-covers-to-tar-with-offset-paths
negative_constraints: Do not compute the offset after `addfile`. That gives the offset of the next member, not the current one.
Do not open the tar in 'w' mode when the file already exists. That truncates previously archived covers.
Do not keep a separate open handle for every tar ever touched. Close the old tar when the bucket switches.
Do not remove local files before the db path update succeeds.
Do not leave the old warc-based archiving path, or a stray debug code line such as `idx = id`, in the module.
procedure: Start in openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py. Reuse `openlibrary.coverstore.config` for `data_root` and `openlibrary.coverstore.db` for DB access. Use absolute package imports. Do not use the implicit relative `import db`.
Build a tar-manager abstraction that keeps one open tar per size bucket: original (''), 'S', 'M' and 'L'.
Derive the tar name from the numeric cover id with `web.numify`, in the form `covers_<id[:4]>_<id[4:6]>.tar`.
For sized files (`id-S.jpg`, `id-M.jpg`, `id-L.jpg`), add the lowercase size prefix, for example `s_covers_0000_00.tar`.
Store tars under `data_root/items/<tarname minus _XX.tar>/<tarname>`. Create the directory if it is missing.
Open the tar in append mode ('a') if it already exists. Otherwise create it in write mode ('w').
When the target tar for a size bucket changes, close the previous handle before opening the next one, so that only one handle per bucket stays open.
When adding a file, build a `TarInfo` with the mtime and the real size from `os.stat(fileobj.name)`. Capture the data offset as `tar.offset + 512` (the header size) before calling `addfile`.
Return the new path as `'<tar basename>:<offset>:<size>'` and update the cover row's filename columns (filename, filename_s/m/l) with these paths in the db.
Delete the local files only after the db update succeeds. Provide a `close()` that closes all open tars at the end of the archive loop.

Add tests under the coverstore tests that cover two things. First, the tar names and size-prefix mapping for plain and `-S/-M/-L` names. Second, that the reported offset and size let you read the exact original bytes back by seeking into the tar.
validation: Run the existing coverstore tests (pytest openlibrary/coverstore/tests).
Write a temporary file through `TarManager.add_file`, parse the returned `name:offset:size`, open the tar file, seek to the offset, read size bytes, and assert they equal the original content.
Assert that `get_tarfile` returns distinct tars for '', S, M and L and reuses the same handle for ids in the same 4/2-digit bucket.
Assert that `close()` leaves no open tar handles and that re-running appends rather than truncates.

name: coverstore-archive-guarantee-tar-close
negative_constraints: 不要在这个 bugfix 中改变归档逻辑、SQL 条件、文件命名(%010d)或 add_file/update/remove 的顺序。
不要用 except 吞掉异常。只用 try/finally，异常仍要向上抛出。
不要把 TarManager() 构造放进 try。否则构造失败时，finally 会引用未定义的 tar_manager。
不要在 finally 中做 DB 更新或删除文件，finally 里只做资源关闭。
不要把 Python 2 语法(print 语句、basestring)顺便改成 Python 3，以免扩大变更面。
procedure: 定位 openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py 中的 archive()。找出 TarManager() 实例化的位置，以及末尾 tar_manager.close() 的调用。
保持 tar_manager = TarManager() 和 _db = db.getdb() 留在 try 之外，在资源创建之后才进入 try。
把 _db.select 及之后的整个 for cover in covers 循环包进 try 块。这部分包括缩略图生成、文件存在性检查、created 时间解析、tar_manager.add_file、_db.update 和 os.remove。
把 tar_manager.close() 移到 finally 块，保证循环里出现异常(IO 错误、DB 错误、KeyboardInterrupt)时，tar 文件和索引仍会被 flush 并关闭。
循环内部逻辑和顺序保持不变，只调整缩进：先 add_file，再 update DB 标记 archived=True，最后删除源文件。
顺手修复文件末尾缺少换行的问题(原文件有 'No newline at end of file')。
validation: 运行 python -m py_compile openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py，确认缩进正确、语法无误。
运行已有测试：pytest openlibrary/coverstore。
人工检查 diff，确认循环体只有缩进变化，并且 tar_manager.close() 只出现在 finally 中。
可选：mock 掉 _db.update 让它抛异常，断言 TarManager.close 仍被调用。

name: coverstore-archive-guard-missing-filenames
negative_constraints: Do not reference a variable that does not exist in the generator expression. The accepted diff wrote `path is None` where `d.path is None` was intended, which raises NameError at runtime. Always use the loop variable's attribute.
Do not raise or exit on a missing or null filename. The archive job is batch processing and must skip the bad cover and continue.
Do not mark a cover as archived or move or tar its files when any variant path is None or missing.
Do not change the tar/archive layout or the data_root/localdisk path convention as part of an error-handling fix.
procedure: Open openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py and find the archive() loop. It iterates covers and builds a files dict holding the original image plus size variants such as S, M and L. Each entry has a .filename and gets a computed .path.

Handle a null or empty filename before calling os.path.join(config.data_root, 'localdisk', d.filename). Covers can lack a filename for one of the size variants, and os.path.join raises TypeError on None. Short-circuit to None, for example `d.path = d.filename and os.path.join(...)`.
Extend the existing missing-file check so that a None path counts as a missing file. Use the loop variable's attribute: `any(d.path is None or not os.path.exists(d.path) for d in files.values())`.
Keep the existing recovery path. Log 'Missing image file for %010d' to web.debug and `continue` to the next cover, so one bad cover does not abort the whole archive run.
Keep the ensure_thumbnail_created(...) call before the path computation. That call may create files that the existence check then depends on.
Match the module's existing Python 2 style (`print >> web.debug`). Do not modernize unrelated code in this fix.
validation: Run `python -m py_compile openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py`, or a pyflakes or flake8 pass, to catch undefined names such as a bare `path`.
Run the existing coverstore tests (openlibrary/coverstore/tests) if present.
Simulate a cover whose filename_s, filename_m or filename_l is None. Confirm archive() logs 'Missing image file' and continues without raising TypeError or NameError.
Simulate a cover with all files present. Confirm it is still archived normally.

name: coverstore-archive-per-item-error-isolation
negative_constraints: Do not put os.remove outside or before the try/move. Deleting the local file after a failed move loses the cover permanently.
Do not let a single exception propagate out of the loop and stop the whole archive run.
Do not swallow errors silently. Always print the cover filename and the traceback.
Do not change the SQL query, the ordering, or the move() semantics as part of this error-handling fix.
Do not convert the file to Python 3 syntax. The coverstore code here uses Python 2 print statements.
procedure: Locate the batch loop in coverstore/coverstore/archive.py, i.e. archive(localdisk, warcdisk). It iterates over web.select('cover', where='archived=false', order='id').

Wrap each cover's whole processing unit in one try block. That unit is move(cover, localdisk, warcdisk) followed by building path = os.path.join(localdisk.root, cover.filename) and calling os.remove(path).
Keep os.remove inside the same try block, after move. That way the local file is deleted only when the move to warcdisk succeeds.
In the except branch, log the identifier of the failed item, e.g. print "failed to move", cover.filename.
Also call traceback.print_exc() so the cause can be diagnosed. Then let the loop continue to the next cover.
Reuse the module's existing style. Use Python 2 print statements, as the existing code does, and plain stdout logging. Do not add a new logging framework.
Leave the move() function unchanged. The fix belongs at the loop level, so one bad cover cannot abort archiving of the rest.
validation: Run the existing coverstore tests, if present.
Do a manual or mock check: make move raise for one cover in the list.
Confirm that the remaining covers are still processed.
Confirm that the failing cover's local file still exists.
Confirm that 'failed to move <filename>' and a traceback are printed.
Check that the module still imports or compiles under the repository's Python 2 interpreter (python -m py_compile).

name: coverstore-archive-progress-and-error-logging
negative_constraints: 不要在这类只加日志的修复里改动归档逻辑、SQL 查询条件或文件路径计算。
不要引入新的 logging 框架或配置, 沿用文件里已有的 print 或 web.debug 写法。
不要把缺文件的跳过逻辑改成抛异常, 否则单个坏 cover 会中断整批归档。
不要在这个 Python 2 文件里改用 print() 函数语法或 f-string。
procedure: 定位 openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py 中的 archive() 主循环, 即遍历 _db.select('cover', where='archived=$f') 的那段代码。
在每个 cover 开始处理时 (计算 id 之后、构建 files 字典之前) 增加一条进度日志, 例如 print 'archiving', cover, 这样运维时能看到当前处理到哪个 cover。
把错误或异常路径的输出 (例如 'Missing image file for %010d') 改为 print >> web.debug, 让它写到 web.py 的调试或错误流, 不再混在普通 stdout 里。
保持该文件现有的 Python 2 语法 (print 语句、basestring), 用 '%010d' % cover.id 格式化 id, 与文件名生成方式保持一致。
日志之后保留原有的控制流, 缺文件时仍然 continue 跳过当前 cover。
validation: python -m py_compile openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py, 确认 Python 2 下语法正确。
在测试库上运行 archive(), 确认每个 cover 都输出 'archiving ...', 缺失文件的 cover 的消息出现在 web.debug (stderr) 中, 并且循环会继续处理下一个。
如果存在相关测试, 运行现有的 coverstore 测试。

name: coverstore-aspect-preserving-resize
negative_constraints: 不要继续对封面尺寸直接调用 img.resize(size), 否则会导致变形。
不要把小图放大到包围盒尺寸, 不超出包围盒的维度应保持原样。
不要使用 img.thumbnail(), 它会就地修改 img。同一个 img 要在循环中依次生成多个尺寸, 就地修改会让后面的尺寸基于已缩小的图生成。
不要让计算出的维度变为 0, 用 max(...,1) 保底。
不要把缩放计算内联在 write_image 中。应放在 utils 里作为可独立测试的函数。
不要修改 config.image_sizes 的语义或输出文件命名。
procedure: 定位 openlibrary/coverstore/code.py 的 write_image: 它会遍历 config.image_sizes 中的每个尺寸, 并为每个尺寸保存一张 '<prefix>-<name>.jpg'。
找出直接调用 img.resize(size, ...) 的位置。PIL 的 resize 会强制缩放到目标尺寸, 这会让封面变形。
在 openlibrary/coverstore/utils.py 新增一个纯函数 resize_image(image, size), 并在该文件 import Image。
resize_image 的逻辑分两步: 若宽度超出 size[0], 按比例缩小高度, 结果用 max(...,1) 保底, 再把宽度设为 size[0]; 然后若高度超出 size[1], 用同样方式按比例缩小宽度, 再把高度设为 size[1]。这一逻辑与 PIL thumbnail 一致, 把尺寸当作包围盒处理。
resize_image 必须返回新的 image.resize((x, y), Image.ANTIALIAS), 不修改原图对象。
在 code.py 中把 resize_image 加入 from utils import ... 的导入列表, 并把循环内的调用改为 resize_image(img, size).save(path)。

在 tests/test_coverstore.py 新增 test_resize_image_aspect_ratio。用 Image.new('RGB', (100, 200)) 构造图片, 断言以下四种情况: 包围盒小于原图时等比缩小 (40,40)->(20,40); 包围盒大于原图时保持原尺寸不放大 (400,400)->(100,200); 高度先受限 (75,100)->(50,100); 宽度先受限 (75,200)->(75,150)。
validation: 运行 openlibrary/coverstore/tests/test_coverstore.py 中已有的 test_write_image、test_bad_image 等测试, 确认仍然通过。
运行新增的 test_resize_image_aspect_ratio, 覆盖包围盒缩小、不放大、高度先受限、宽度先受限四种情况。
确认原图对象的 size 在多次调用 resize_image 后保持不变。

name: coverstore-config-dict-kwargs-unpacking
negative_constraints: Do not change the shape of the db_parameters config, for example by turning it into a DSN string, as part of this fix.
Do not replace the cached _db global with a new connection on every call.
procedure: Open coverstore/coverstore/db.py. Find every call that passes a config dict straight into a web.py factory, such as web.database(config.db_parameters).
Change the call to keyword unpacking: web.database(**config.db_parameters). web.database accepts only keyword parameters (dbn, db, user, pw, host).
Keep the module-level _db lazy singleton pattern in getdb(). Only fix how the arguments are passed.
Grep coverstore for other config.<name> dicts that are handed to constructors. Confirm each one is unpacked, or confirm the callee really expects a dict.
validation: Load the config with run.load_config. Then call db.getdb() and run a trivial query, for example get_category_id, to confirm the connection works.
Run the existing coverstore tests if there are any.

name: coverstore-db-portable-queries-and-notfound
negative_constraints: 不要在 SQL 字符串里写 postgres 专有语法, 如 `at time zone`、`::type` 或布尔字面量。测试用的是 sqlite。
不要用字符串拼接把值写进 SQL, 必须用 web.py 的 `$var` 参数绑定。
不要对缺失资源返回 200 加空 JSON body。
procedure: 定位 openlibrary/coverstore/db.py 里的原始 SQL。重点查数据库方言相关的表达式, 例如 `current_timestamp at time zone 'utc'` 和字面量 `true`。
把这些表达式改为在 Python 中求值, 再用 `$var` 绑定变量通过 `vars=locals()` 传入。例如 `now = datetime.datetime.utcnow()`, `t = True`。这样 sqlite 测试库和 postgres 生产库都能执行同一条 SQL。
需要时间戳时, 在 db.py 中 `import datetime`, 统一使用 UTC 的 `utcnow()`。不要依赖数据库端的时区函数。
定位 code.py 中返回 JSON 的 handler, 例如 `cover_details.GET`。如果 `_query` 结果为空, 应 `raise web.notfound("")`, 不要返回 `null`/空 JSON。有结果时才 `simplejson.dumps(d)`。
保持 `web.header('Content-Type', 'application/json')` 等现有行为不变, 只在空结果分支上做改动。
validation: 在 openlibrary/coverstore/tests 下运行 py.test。测试通过 `_setup.setup_module(mod, db=True)` 使用 sqlite 库。
为 `touch` 和 `delete` 增加用例: 在 sqlite 上执行后查询 `last_modified` 已更新、`deleted` 为真。
为 `cover_details` 增加查询不存在 key 的用例, 断言抛出或返回 404。

name: coverstore-extract-generic-helpers-to-coverlib
negative_constraints: 不要在 coverlib.py 中 import code.py 或 web handler 类。
不要只移动函数却不修改 archive.py 等调用方, 否则会出现残留的 code.xxx AttributeError。
测试里的 monkeypatch 不要继续指向 code.find_image_path 这类旧路径, 否则 patch 不会生效。
不要改变函数签名或返回格式, 例如 'tarname:offset:size' 这个字符串格式, 因为数据库里已存的路径依赖它。
修改 TarManager 元组结构时, 不要漏掉 close() 或 get_tarfile 中任何一处解包。
procedure: 定位 openlibrary/coverstore/code.py 中与 web handler 无关的通用函数, 例如 find_image_path、ensure_thumbnail_created、save_image 和缩略图生成辅助函数。
把这些函数移到 openlibrary/coverstore/coverlib.py 中。coverlib 只依赖 config/db/PIL 等底层模块, 不能 import code.py, 以免形成循环依赖。
在 code.py 中改为 from openlibrary.coverstore.coverlib import ... 引入这些函数, 保留 handler 原有调用名, 让 web 行为不变。
全局 grep 'code\.' 的调用方, 比如 archive.py 里的 code.ensure_thumbnail_created 和 code.find_image_path。把它们改成从 coverlib 直接 import 函数, 并从 import 列表中删掉 code。
更新 tests: 把原来针对 code.* 函数的单测改为 import coverlib 并测试同名函数。monkeypatch 的目标也要改成 coverlib 模块路径, 因为函数现在在 coverlib 的命名空间里查找。
如果同一个 PR 顺带修改了 archive 的 TarManager, 例如每个 tar 同时写一个 .index 文件, 需要同步修改以下几处: tarfiles 初始化的元组长度、get_tarfile 的解包和返回值、open_tarfile 的返回值、add_file 的调用方, 以及 close 中关闭所有句柄的逻辑。
validation: 运行 pytest openlibrary/coverstore/tests。
执行 python -c 'import openlibrary.coverstore.archive, openlibrary.coverstore.code, openlibrary.coverstore.coverlib', 确认没有循环导入。
执行 grep -rn 'code\.\(find_image_path\|ensure_thumbnail_created\|save_image\)' openlibrary/coverstore, 结果应为空。
如果改了 archive: 在临时 data_root 下调用 TarManager.add_file 和 close, 确认 .tar 与 .index 都已生成, 且 index 的行内容与返回的 offset/size 一致。

name: coverstore-image-service-replacement
negative_constraints: Do not leave any imports, config references or tests that point to the old coverthing package.
Do not build the WARCDisk or another disk object with hard-coded paths inside config.py. Inject it at deploy/run time.
Do not return an image without first validating size against SIZES. Return web.notfound() for unknown sizes and missing ids.
Do not let int() raise on user input. Always use safeint with a default.
Do not silently claim that source_url download is supported. Keep it explicitly marked as unimplemented, or implement and test it.
procedure: Locate the legacy package (coverthing/coverthing/*). Inventory every module, URL route, and config key that callers still depend on before replacing anything.
Create the new package as coverstore/coverstore/. Give __init__.py a module docstring that states its purpose: an image store for Open Library book covers and author photos.

Move config.py with git mv/rename so history is kept. Keep only the keys the new code actually reads (image_engine, image_sizes, cache_dir, disk). Drop obsolete keys such as cache_size and redirect_amazon_images, and drop hard-coded disk construction.

Organize code.py around a web.py urls tuple. Routes are keyed by category: /<category>/upload (POST), /<category>/<key>/<value>/(small|medium|large).jpg (GET), /<category>/query (GET, JSON/JSONP), and /<category>/touch (POST).
Do not instantiate global resources (_disk, _cache) at import time. Initialize them inside run(), take them from config.disk and config.cache_dir, and assert that config.disk is set.
Resolve image lookups through a single helper (_query). key=='id' maps to int(value). key=='olid' maps to the first db.query result. Any other key returns None, which leads to notfound.
Parse every numeric input with safeint(value, default) and cover it with doctests. This includes offset, limit and id.
For query responses, set Content-Type to text/javascript. Wrap the JSON as callback(json); only when a callback parameter is given.
Add tests next to the new package: doctests for helpers, and unit tests for db/imagecache/disk with a temporary directory. Remove or redirect any tests that still import coverthing.
validation: Run python -m doctest coverstore/coverstore/code.py and confirm the safeint doctests pass.
Run the existing test suite and confirm nothing imports coverthing (grep -r coverthing).
Smoke-test with a temporary config.disk/cache_dir: upload an image, fetch /b/id/<id>/small.jpg, query with and without a callback, and touch an id.
Request an invalid size or a nonexistent olid and confirm the response is 404.

name: coverstore-immutable-cache-headers-by-id
negative_constraints: 不要给 olid、isbn、lccn、oclc、ocaid 查询或 default image 重定向加长期 public 缓存，因为它们指向的封面会变。
不要让 _query 不同分支混着返回 int 和 row 对象。
设置缓存头不要依赖后续 serve_file 或 xsendfile 路径，必须在发送文件之前完成。
不要只做空白或格式改动，也不要做无关重构。
procedure: 先定位 coverstore/coverstore/code.py 里的 `cover.GET` 和 `_query(category, key, value)`。只有 key=='id' 的请求，URL 才唯一且永久对应一张图。olid、isbn 等 key 会随时间改指向，属于可变映射。
在 coverstore/coverstore/db.py 新增 `details(id)`，写法为 `web.select('cover', what='*', where="id=$id", vars=locals()).list()`，返回完整行，其中包含 created 字段。
把 `_query` 的返回值从裸 id 改成完整行对象，写法为 `result and result[0] or None`。id 分支调用 db.details；olid 分支返回 result[0]，不再返回 result[0].id。isbn、lccn 等其余分支也要检查，确保返回同样的行对象，否则后续访问 `d.id` 会出错。
在 `cover.GET` 中，只在 key=='id' 时设置缓存头：`web.lastmodified(d.created)`、`web.header('Cache-Control','public')`、`web.expires(100*365*24*3600)`。这三个调用要放在 serve_file 之前。
把所有下游调用改成使用 `d.id`，例如 `_cache.get_image(d.id, size)`。
用 grep 列出 `_query` 的所有调用方，并适配新的返回类型。
validation: 请求 /b/id/<id>-M.jpg，确认响应包含 Cache-Control: public、远期的 Expires，以及等于 created 的 Last-Modified。
请求 /b/olid/<olid>-M.jpg，确认响应没有长期缓存头，且图片仍能正常返回。
请求不存在的 id，确认仍走 default image 逻辑，不报 AttributeError。
带 If-Modified-Since 请求 id URL，确认返回 304。
运行现有的 coverstore 测试。

name: coverstore-lazy-thumbnail-generation-fix
negative_constraints: 不要用尺寸文件路径通过 rsplit('-') 反推原图路径。这样容易与真实文件名中的 '-' 冲突,导致判断失效。
不要把存在性判断写反:原图存在才生成,缩略图已存在则跳过。
不要对含 ':' 的归档路径做 os.path.exists 或 open 操作。
不要遗留 write_image 产生的重复原图 .jpg 文件。
不要假设 d['filename_'+size] 一定非空。
procedure: 定位 openlibrary/coverstore/code.py 中的 serve_image 与 ensure_thumnnail_created。
在解析具体尺寸文件名之前调用缩略图补建逻辑。传入原图路径 find_image_path(d.filename),不要传某个尺寸文件的路径。
补建前先检查。路径含 ':' 时(tar/归档偏移形式,不在本地文件系统)直接返回。<orig>-S.jpg 已存在时也直接返回。
原图 path 不存在时直接返回,因为无法生成缩略图。注意条件方向是 'not os.path.exists'。
生成时以 os.path.basename(原图路径) 作为 prefix 调用 write_image,并断言 prefix 不以 .jpg 结尾。
write_image 会额外写出一份 '<path>.jpg' 原图副本,生成后用 os.remove 删除它。
更新 cover 表的 filename_s/filename_m/filename_l 为 prefix + '-S/-M/-L.jpg'。
serve_image 中尺寸列为空(迁移期 NULL)时,回退为 d.filename + '-%s.jpg' % size.upper()。
validation: 运行现有 coverstore 测试(openlibrary/coverstore/tests)。
手工验证四种情况:filename_s 为 NULL 的封面请求 -S/-M/-L 能生成缩略图并返回;生成后 DB 字段已更新;原图缺失时不报错;路径含 ':' 时不触发生成。
确认生成后没有残留 <orig>.jpg 副本。

name: coverstore-refactor-image-storage-with-utils-and-tests
negative_constraints: 不要在 write_image 的清理分支里只删一部分文件。原图和全部尺寸文件都要删, 删除用 path_prefix 而不是原始 prefix, 避免路径不一致导致残留。
不要保留 urllib._urlopener 之类的模块级副作用。
不要在测试中访问真实的 openlibrary.org API。
不要只改 code.py 而不补测试, 本任务的维护面要求同时包含 code 和 tests。
procedure: 定位 openlibrary/coverstore/code.py 中混杂的辅助函数, 包括 safeint、urldecode、changequery、download、load_image、ol_things 以及全局 _cache/_disk。
把通用辅助函数(safeint、rm_f、random_string 等)抽到 openlibrary/coverstore/utils.py, 在 code.py 中用 `from utils import ...` 复用。原有 doctest 随函数一起迁移, 不要丢弃。
去掉模块级全局状态和 run() 中的 imagecache 初始化, 把存储逻辑集中到一个函数里, 例如 write_image(data, prefix)。
write_image 的处理顺序: 先保存原图 prefix.jpg; 用 Image.open(StringIO(data)) 打开; 非 RGB 模式先 convert('RGB'); 再按 config.image_sizes 生成 -S/-M/-L 缩略图。
write_image 捕获 IOError 后, 删除已写出的原图和全部尺寸文件(rm_f), 然后返回 None, 让调用方映射到 ERROR_BAD_IMAGE。
扩展 urls 路由并保持两种 URL 形式都可用: 带尺寸的 `-([SML]).jpg`, 不带尺寸的原图 `().jpg`(空 size 组)。同时新增 `.json` 详情路由 cover_details。
为新路由、write_image 和 utils 增加测试: 用临时目录覆盖 config 中的数据目录和 image_sizes, 用小的 PIL 生成图片验证各尺寸文件存在, 用坏数据验证清理逻辑和 None 返回值。
validation: 运行现有 coverstore 测试和 utils 中的 doctest (python -m doctest openlibrary/coverstore/utils.py)。
分别对 -S.jpg、-M.jpg、-L.jpg、原图 .jpg 和 .json 请求 app.request, 确认路由都能匹配。
对非 RGB 图片(如 P 或 RGBA 模式)调用 write_image, 确认能生成 JPEG。
用损坏的图片数据调用 write_image, 确认返回 None 且磁盘上没有残留文件。

name: coverstore-release-webctx-upload-buffers
negative_constraints: Do not call _cleanup() before reading web.ctx.ip or other env-derived values that save_image or the redirects need. Capture them first, for example as local variables.
Do not clean up only the success path. Exception and error() paths raise and skip trailing code, so each raise site needs its own cleanup.
Do not use del web.ctx[...] or attribute deletion that raises KeyError when the key is missing. Use pop(key, None).
Do not replace web.ctx itself or touch unrelated ctx keys such as headers or status. They are needed to send the response.
procedure: In openlibrary/coverstore/code.py, find the web.py POST handlers that accept uploaded image data (upload, upload2). They call web.input(...) or read web.data().

Know why they leak: web.py caches the parsed multipart body in web.ctx._fieldstorage and the raw body in web.ctx._data. web.ctx.env also holds a reference to wsgi.input. As long as those references live, the whole image buffer stays alive.

Add one module-level helper, _cleanup(), next to the handlers: web.ctx.pop('_fieldstorage', None); web.ctx.pop('_data', None); web.ctx.env = {}. Use it everywhere instead of repeating the pops inline.
Call _cleanup() on every exit path of each handler. Put it right before the success redirect or return, such as raise web.seeother(success_url) or return simplejson.dumps(...).

Also call _cleanup() at the start of the nested error() closure, before it builds the redirect or badrequest and raises. This makes the failure paths (missing data, bad image, ValueError) release the buffers too.

In the error path, read any values you need from web.ctx.env before calling _cleanup(), because cleanup empties env. Examples are HTTP_REFERRER and ip. In upload the failure and success URLs are already computed before cleanup.

If a handler only needs the parsed input dict i, you may pop _fieldstorage and _data immediately after web.input(), as upload2 does. This releases the buffers early, but the final _cleanup() is still required.
validation: Run the existing coverstore tests (openlibrary/coverstore/tests) and confirm that upload and upload2 still return a redirect or JSON id.
Manually POST a valid image and an invalid image to both endpoints. Confirm success, the badrequest JSON, and the failure redirect all behave as before, with no AttributeError or KeyError.
Optionally loop large uploads and watch process RSS stay flat, or use gc.get_referrers on the data buffer to confirm nothing holds it after the request.

name: coverstore-run-entrypoint-argv-and-subcommand
negative_constraints: Do not assign a tuple, or a list without argv[0], to sys.argv.
Do not index sys.argv positionally while optional flags are still in it.
Do not import the archive module at top level. It should load only when that mode is selected.
procedure: Open coverstore/run.py. When you rewrite sys.argv before handing control to web.py (code.run()), keep the program name: sys.argv = [sys.argv[0]] + list(args). web.py reads sys.argv[1] as the port or address, so dropping argv[0] shifts every argument.

Turn each special mode, such as --archive, into its own function (def archive(configfile)). That function calls load_config, then lazy-imports its module (from coverstore import archive), then does its work.

In the __main__ dispatch, remove the flag from sys.argv (sys.argv.remove('--archive')) before you take positional arguments. This keeps sys.argv[1] pointing at the config file whatever the flag's position.
Read the nested config path that the loaded config actually uses, config.disk.disks rather than config.disks. Check the attribute path against the sample config before using it.
validation: Run `python coverstore/run.py <conf> <port>` and confirm the server binds to the given port.

Run `python coverstore/run.py <conf> --archive` and also `python coverstore/run.py --archive <conf>`. Confirm both load the config and call archive.archive with disks[0] and disks[1] without an AttributeError.

name: coverstore-tar-index-entry-vs-locator
negative_constraints: 不要在 .index 行里写 tar 文件名,否则按成员名查找封面会失败,无法从 tar 中读出封面。
不要在返回的 locator 里写成员名,调用方要靠 tar 文件名定位归档包。
不要在 addfile 之后再读 tar.offset 作为偏移,那时它已指向下一个成员。
不要改变 index 行的 tab 分隔格式和 locator 的冒号分隔格式,下游解析依赖这两种格式。
procedure: 打开 openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py,找到 TarManager.add_file(或写入 tar 和 .index 文件的那个方法)。
分清两种输出,各自用对应的标识:
- 写入每个 tar 旁 .index 文件的那一行,第一列是成员名,即传入的 `name` / tarinfo.name。
- 方法返回、并存进 DB 的 locator 字符串格式为 `<tar basename>:<offset>:<size>`,tar 名用 os.path.basename(tar.name)。
不要为两者共用一个 info 元组。index.write 和 return 各自构造参数:index 行用 (name, offset, tarinfo.size);locator 用 (os.path.basename(tar.name), offset, tarinfo.size)。
offset 保持为 addfile 之前取的 `tar.offset + 512`,即跳过 512 字节 tar 头之后的数据起点。
修改只限这个方法,不要改 tarinfo 的构造方式,也不要改 tarfiles 字典的结构。
validation: 运行现有的 openlibrary/coverstore 测试(pytest openlibrary/coverstore)。
手工验证:用 TarManager 归档一个小文件,检查 .index 行是 `<membername>\t<offset>\t<size>`,返回值是 `<tarname>.tar:<offset>:<size>`。
确认从 tar 文件的 offset 处读取 size 字节,得到的内容与原文件一致。

name: coverstore-test-setup-helper-module
negative_constraints: 不要在 tests 目录放名为 `setup.py` 的文件。
不要在每个测试里重复建库逻辑, 应复用 `_setup`。
teardown 中必须执行 `root.remove(rec=True)` 清理临时目录, 不要遗留文件。
procedure: 测试辅助模块应命名为 `_setup.py`, 不要叫 `setup.py`。`setup.py` 会被打包工具或测试收集器误识别, 也会遮蔽同名模块。所有测试文件都用 `import _setup` 引用它。
在 `_setup.setup_db(mod, root)` 中创建 sqlite 库, 按 `;` 拆分 schema 后逐条执行, 并插入默认 category 'b'。然后执行 `mod.db = db`, 把 db 句柄挂到测试模块上, 供用例直接校验数据库状态。
测试模块的 `setup_module`/`teardown_module` 委托给 `_setup.setup_module(mod, db=...)` 和 `_setup.teardown_module(mod)`。按需执行 `mod.root.mkdir(...)` 建立 items 和 localdisk 目录结构。
新增的 db 相关测试(touch/delete/query)写在启用 `db=True` 的测试模块里, 通过 `mod.db` 读取并断言结果。
为 generator 测试(yield 风格)补充 docstring, 说明覆盖的图片格式(jpg/gif/png)和场景。
validation: 运行 py.test openlibrary/coverstore/tests, 确认重命名后所有测试仍能被收集和执行。
确认在 tests 目录下 grep `import setup` 无残留引用。

name: coverstore-upload-error-redirect-hardening
negative_constraints: 不要在 error 路径中调用未定义的辅助函数。这类问题只会在出错时暴露，正常流程测不到。
不要让 else 分支默认走某种输入来源，必须显式处理“既没有 URL 也没有文件”的情况。
不要只依赖 HTTP_REFERRER，它可能为空。
不要在重命名函数时遗漏调用点，可以 grep 旧名字确认。
procedure: 定位 coverstore/coverstore/code.py 里的 upload.POST，以及它内部的 error() 闭包。
检查 error() 调用的辅助函数是否真的存在，比如原代码调用了不存在的 change_query。如果没有，就在本模块里实现 urldecode 和 changequery：用 urllib.splitquery 拆出 query，用 unquote/unquote_plus 解码，合并新参数后再用 urlencode 重新编码。函数里要附带 doctest。
给重定向目标加兜底链：i.failure_url，然后 web.ctx.get('HTTP_REFERRER')，最后 web.ctx.fullpath。success_url 也按同样方式处理，保证永远不会重定向到 None。
错误参数使用带前缀的名称 errcode 和 errmsg，避免和目标 URL 里已有的查询参数冲突。
把输入分支补完整：有 source_url 时下载，下载失败报 ERROR_INVALID_URL；有非空的 file 时取 file.value；两者都没有时显式报 ERROR_EMPTY。不要让 data 处于未定义状态。
检查函数内延迟导入的模块名大小写是否正确，例如 cStringIO 而不是 CStringIO。用 is_valid_image(data) 这种表达布尔判断的命名，并同步更新所有调用点。
validation: 运行 python -m doctest coverstore/coverstore/code.py，验证 urldecode 和 changequery 的 doctest。
手动或用 web.py 测试客户端发起 POST，分别覆盖三种情况：无文件也无 URL、非法 URL、非图片数据。确认 303 重定向的 URL 里带有 errcode 和 errmsg。
用 pyflakes 检查是否有未定义名称。

name: coverstore-upload-restore-missing-utils-import
negative_constraints: Do not reimplement download logic inline in code.py. Reuse utils.download.
Do not wrap the call in a bare try/except to hide the NameError. Add the missing import.
Do not reorder or rename the existing URL routing tuple or the other imports.
Do not convert this module's Python 2 syntax to Python 3 as part of a bugfix.
procedure: Start from openlibrary/coverstore/code.py. Find `class upload` and the handlers it calls, such as the path that fetches by source_url/URL.
Collect every helper the handler calls without a module prefix, for example download, safeint, rm_f, random_string, resize_image, ol_things and changequery.

Compare those names with the line `from utils import ...` at the top of the file. Any name that is defined in openlibrary/coverstore/utils.py but missing from the import list is the source of the runtime NameError.
Add the missing name (here `download`) to the existing `from utils import ...` line. Do not create a second import statement.
Confirm that the helper's signature in utils.py matches how upload calls it.
Keep the existing implicit relative import style (`import db`, `import config`, `from utils import`). Do not switch it to absolute paths.
validation: python -c 'import ast,sys; ast.parse(open("openlibrary/coverstore/code.py").read())' (under Python 2), or run pyflakes on code.py and check that no undefined names are reported.
Exercise upload with a source_url and confirm it no longer fails with a NameError on download.
Run any existing coverstore tests.

name: coverstore-webpy-db-call-correctness-sweep
negative_constraints: 不要假设 web.select 返回单个 Storage 对象就直接访问属性。
不要在 where 字符串里直接拼接 Python 变量名，也不要用字符串格式化拼进用户数据；只能用 $var 配合 vars 传值。
不要在修复中留下调试用的 print，除非这是脚本有意输出的进度信息，并且需要和维护者确认。
不要为了清理顺手改 db schema 或列名，应该让代码去匹配现有 schema。
procedure: 先定位 coverstore/coverstore/archive.py 及同目录下的其他脚本。逐个检查文件顶部是否导入了实际用到的模块，例如 web、os。缺了就补上，否则运行时会抛 NameError。
检查每个 web.select 调用。它返回的是结果迭代器，不是单行对象。要取单行时用 web.select(...)[0].field，或用 list(...)，不要直接写 .field。
检查每个 where= 字符串。变量插值必须写成 $var 形式，并配合 vars=locals() 传值，例如 where='id=$cover.id'。只写裸名称，比如 'id=cover.id'，SQL 会把它当成列名。
把 where 子句里的列名和 schema 对照一遍，例如 archived 和 archive 不能拼错。必要时打开 coverstore 的 schema 或 db.py 确认。
传给外部存储的参数（例如 warcdisk.write 的 params）里如果有 datetime 字段，先显式格式化成字符串，例如 strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')。
统一修正缩进。Python 2 文件里不能混用 3 个空格和 4 个空格，否则会出现 IndentationError，或者语句落到错误的代码块里。
validation: 对改动的文件运行 python -m py_compile，确认语法和缩进正确。
用 pyflakes 检查未定义名称和未使用的导入。
在测试数据库上运行 archive()，确认 select 能用 archived=false 取到行，并且 update 只改动了 id 匹配的那一行。

name: defensive-solr-reply-field-access
negative_constraints: Do not compare numFound to a string literal. In parsed JSON it is an int.
Do not return None where callers iterate. Return an empty list of the same shape.
Do not wrap the whole function in a bare try/except. Network and JSON errors should stay visible.
Do not change the Solr query URL or the fl parameters as part of this fix.
procedure: Locate the helper in openlibrary/plugins/worksearch/code.py that parses the Solr JSON reply. Look for code that reads reply['response']['docs'][0][field], for example sorted_work_editions.
Before indexing docs[0], guard the empty-result case and return the same type the callers already expect. When the callers iterate over a list of keys, return [].
Make the empty check robust. Test `not reply['response'].get('docs')` or `int(numFound) == 0`. Solr wt=json returns numFound as an int, so comparing it to the string '0' never matches.
Read optional multi-valued fields such as edition_key with doc.get(field, []) instead of doc[field]. Solr omits a field entirely when a document has no values for it.
Keep the function signature unchanged, including the json_data injection parameter, so tests can still pass a canned reply.
Check every caller of the helper and confirm it handles an empty list without crashing or rendering broken links.
validation: Run the existing worksearch tests (pytest openlibrary/plugins/worksearch).
Call the helper with json_data='{"response":{"numFound":0,"docs":[]}}' and assert it returns [].
Call it with a doc that lacks edition_key and assert it returns [].
Call it with a normal reply and assert the edition_key list is returned unchanged.

name: document-marc-merge-required-fields
negative_constraints: 不要在添加字段文档时顺带修改 re_year、re_amazon_title_paren 等已有正则或比较阈值。
不要列出合并逻辑并未读取的字段, 也不要遗漏 authors、publish_country 这类容易被忽视的字段。
不要把这份清单拆散到多个模块里重复维护。它只放在 merge_marc.py 一处。
procedure: 定位 catalog/merge/merge_marc.py。它是 MARC/Amazon 记录匹配合并的核心模块, 依赖 names.match_name 和 normalize.normalize。
通读模块内所有比较函数, 例如 title、isbn、lccn、publisher、date、pages、authors 相关的比较逻辑。逐个枚举它们实际读取的记录键, 不要凭印象列字段。
把字段清单写成模块级注释, 放在 import 之后、正则常量之前。以本 PR 为例, 清单是: title_prefix, title, subtitle, isbn, publish_country, lccn, publishers, publish_date, number_of_pages, authors。
使用记录 dict 中实际出现的键名, 例如 publishers(复数)、number_of_pages, 不要改写成自然语言名称。
调用方 (import/build_marc 等) 构造合并输入时, 以该清单为准。确保每个字段都被提取, 缺失时给出明确的空值约定。
validation: 在 catalog/merge 下运行现有测试 (例如 test_merge_marc 或 nose/pytest), 确认没有行为变化。
用 grep 检查 merge_marc.py 中被访问的每个记录键 (形如 rec['...'] 和 .get('...')) 都出现在注释清单里, 反向也一致。
确认文件在 Python2 下仍可 import, 不引入语法变化。

name: drop-webpy-fieldstorage-refs-after-upload-input
negative_constraints: Do not call web.input again after the pop and expect to get the file content back. The cache is gone, so the second parse would be empty or fail.
Do not change the web.input default arguments (file={}, url=""). Doing so breaks the URL upload path or the file-type detection.
Do not clear all of web.ctx, and do not reset any key other than _fieldstorage.
Do not move the pop to before web.input.
procedure: Locate the openlibrary/plugins/** handlers (delegate.page subclasses) that read multipart uploads via web.input(file={}, ...), for example add_cover in openlibrary/plugins/upstream/covers.py.

Background: when web.py parses multipart input it caches the cgi.FieldStorage object in web.ctx._fieldstorage. That object holds the uploaded file content and its temp file. Because web.ctx is thread-local and reused across requests, the large upload is not released promptly.

Right after the web.input(...) call, once the needed values are in the returned storage object i, add `web.ctx.pop("_fieldstorage", None)`. Precede it with a short comment saying why it is there (remove references to field storage objects).
Use pop with a default of None so a missing key causes no error. Do not use del, and do not assume the key exists.
Make sure the later logic (self.upload(key, i), self.save, and so on) only uses the local i and its file fields, and that nothing calls web.input again to read the raw upload.
Search for other web.input(file=...) or multipart handlers with the same pattern, such as author photo or other cover/image uploads, and decide whether each needs the same fix.
validation: Run the existing test suite (pytest openlibrary).
Manually test the cover upload by local file and by URL, and confirm the cover id is still saved to the book.
Confirm that a request without a multipart body does not throw (the pop default of None covers this).
Optionally upload a large file several times in a row and check that process memory does not keep growing.

name: elementtree-element-truthiness-check
negative_constraints: Do not use bare 'if element:' or 'if not element:' on XML Element objects.
Do not iterate the result of .find() without a None check.
procedure: Find conditionals that test an ElementTree or lxml element directly, such as 'if spellcheck:' after root.find(...).
An Element's truthiness is based on its child count, not on whether it exists. A found element with no children evaluates as False, and a missing one is None.
Replace the test with 'if el is not None and len(el):' when the following code iterates children. Use 'if el is not None:' when only existence matters.
Guard nested finds as well (e.g. spellcheck.find("lst[@name='suggestions']") can return None before iteration).
validation: Run existing worksearch tests.
Feed do_search a Solr XML response with no spellcheck block, an empty spellcheck block, and one with suggestions. Confirm there is no exception and spell_map is filled only in the last case.

name: escape-user-input-before-solr-query
negative_constraints: Do not escape the whole constructed query. That would neutralize intended syntax such as the trailing '*' wildcard, field prefixes and OR/AND.
Do not write separate inline escaping at each call site. Centralize it in the Solr.escape helper.
Do not add the wildcard '*' before escaping. It would be escaped and prefix matching would stop working.
Do not change the q_op, sort or field semantics of the existing select call. This is an input-sanitization fix only.
Do not leave __main__ code that needs a live Solr instance (for example localhost:8986) as the module's test path.
procedure: Find every call site that interpolates raw request input (e.g. i.q from web.input) into a Solr query string. Typical places are openlibrary/plugins/upstream/addbook.py (authors_autocomplete) and other autocomplete or search handlers that use '%s' formatting or string concatenation before solr.select(...).

Reuse or add one escape method on the Solr client class in openlibrary/utils/solr.py: `def escape(self, query)`. It should backslash-escape the Lucene special characters `+ - ! ( ) { } [ ] ^ " ~ * ? : \\`.
Implement escape with `pattern = '([%s])' % re.escape(chars)`, then call `web.re_compile(pattern).sub(r'\\\1', query)`. Add `import re` at the top of the module.

At the call site, escape only the user-supplied part, then append the operators or wildcards the code controls. For example, `name = solr.escape(i.q) + '*'`, then `q = 'name:(%s) OR alternate_names:(%s)' % (name, name)`.
Give escape a doctest such as `solr.escape('a[b]c') -> 'a\\[b\\]c'`. Use a raw docstring (r""") so the backslashes in the expected output are not misread.
If the module's __main__ block contains ad-hoc code that hits a live server, you may replace it with `import doctest; doctest.testmod()` so the module can test itself.
validation: Run `python openlibrary/utils/solr.py` or `python -m doctest openlibrary/utils/solr.py` and check that the escape doctest passes.
Run the existing test suite (for example py.test openlibrary) to confirm nothing else breaks.
Call the autocomplete endpoint with inputs such as 'a[b', 'foo:bar', 'x(y' and '"'. Each should return JSON results, not a Solr 400/500 parse error.
Check that a plain prefix input such as 'twa' still returns prefix matches, which confirms the wildcard was appended after escaping.

name: expose-solr-field-in-worksearch-work-object
negative_constraints: 不要只改 work_object 而不改 fl 参数：字段不会被 solr 返回，结果永远是 None。
不要只更新一个 solr_select 查询：共享 work_object 的其他页面（subjects）会不一致。
不要对可能缺失的 solr 字段使用 w['x'] 直接取值，要用存在性判断或 w.get。
不要改动 facet_fields、排序或分页参数，这些与本次修复无关。
procedure: 定位 openlibrary/plugins/worksearch/code.py 中的 work_object(w)。它把 solr doc 转成模板使用的 work 对象。
在 work_object 的 storage/dict 构造中新增目标字段，例如 first_publish_year。
solr 中多值字段要做安全取值：取第一个元素，字段缺失时回退为 None，例如 (w['field'][0] if 'field' in w else None)。不要直接索引，否则缺失时会 KeyError。
grep 所有构造 solr_select 并以 work_object 消费结果的查询。至少包括 works_by_author（作者页）和 subjects.GET（主题页）。
在每个查询的 fl= 参数列表末尾追加新字段名，使 solr 实际返回该字段。
确认模板（作者页/主题页）读取的属性名与 work_object 中新增的 key 一致。
validation: run existing tests（如 openlibrary/plugins/worksearch 下的测试）
用一个作者 key 调用 works_by_author，检查返回的 work 含 first_publish_year，缺失时为 None 且不抛异常。
渲染作者页和主题页，确认年份正常显示，无 KeyError。

name: extract-marc-db-web-formatting-module
negative_constraints: Do not leave duplicate helper definitions in both web_ui.py and web_marc_db.py.
Do not keep web.load() or DB configuration side effects in both files. Database initialization should live in one place only.

Do not change the HTML escaping behavior (& < > to entities, newline to
) or the output format during a move-only refactor.
Do not add a circular import: web_marc_db must not import web_ui.
Do not silently delete the slow-path code. Comment it out with the reason.
procedure: Locate catalog/marc/db/web_ui.py. Identify everything other than the web.py controller and the random ISBN logic: rc/DB setup, the esc/HTML escaping helpers, the marc_authors/marc_title/marc_publisher formatters, src_list/counts_html/list_to_html, the marc_data cache, list_works, and the search and location display logic.

Create a sibling module, catalog/marc/db/web_marc_db.py, and move these helpers into it. Keep the original names and their dependencies: read_rc, get_data, the fast_parse functions, sources and find_others.
Have the new module expose public entry points such as search_query and show_locs. web_ui.py imports only these (from web_marc_db import search_query, show_locs).
Shrink web_ui.py to the imports it actually uses (random, web) plus the request handling and the random_isbn logic.

When replacing slow or environment-dependent initialization, write the change down explicitly. Examples: comment out the slow `order by random()` SQL, and point isbn_file/isbn_count at a relative path and a fixed count. Leave the original approach as a comment explaining why it was replaced ('too slow').

While moving code, fix obviously broken references. For example, marc_publisher calls get_all_subfield without arguments; it should call get_all_subfields(line), guarded with `if line`. Also check that db_isbn and similar globals still exist in the new module, or are explicitly commented out.

trigger.task_type: refactor/bugfix: split web UI entrypoint from MARC DB formatting/query helpers

validation: Run python -c 'import web_ui' from catalog/marc/db (Python 2) and confirm there are no ImportError or NameError failures.
grep that every name used in web_ui.py is either defined there or imported from web_marc_db.
Run pyflakes on both files to catch undefined names such as db_isbn and get_all_subfield.
Manually load the page with an ISBN query and with a random ISBN, and confirm the rendered output matches the pre-refactor output.

name: fast-parse-add-full-title-from-245ab
negative_constraints: Do not apply prefix_len (non-filing characters) truncation to full_title. The merge code normalises the full title itself.
Do not include subfields c or h in full_title. They are statement of responsibility and medium.
Do not add a second pass over get_subfields. Collect full_title in the same loop.
Do not set full_title when subfield a is absent. Preserve the early return.
procedure: Locate read_full_title(line, edition) in catalog/marc/fast_parse.py, which iterates get_subfields(line, ['a','b','c','h']).
Inside the existing subfield loop, append to a local full_title list only when k is 'a' or 'b'. Strip each value with v.strip(' /,;:'), the same punctuation set used for title.
Keep the early `return` when 'a' is missing, and keep the existing title / prefix_len logic intact.
Read prefix_len directly as int(line[1]) inside the try. Do not hold the raw char in a variable that the except branch would overwrite with None.
After computing title, set edition['full_title'] = ' '.join(full_title). This is the untruncated a+b title, independent of the non-filing prefix_len.
Keep edition['title'] semantics unchanged (subfield a only, with the prefix stripped), because existing callers depend on it.
validation: Run existing catalog/marc tests.
Parse a sample 245 line with $a, $b and $c. Check that full_title equals 'a b' without trailing ' /:;,' and excludes $c.
Check a record with indicator2 (prefix_len) > 0. title should have the prefix stripped; full_title should keep it.
Check a record with a non-digit indicator. It must not raise, and title should be the full $a.

name: filter-empty-entries-in-delimited-form-fields
negative_constraints: 不要只按 `if name` 过滤。'  ' 这类纯空白项会漏过去, 守卫条件必须基于 strip 之后的值。
不要改变分隔符的语义 (换行和 ';' 都要继续当作分隔符)。
不要去重或重新排序名称。这超出了本次修复范围, 而且会改变用户可见的数据。
不要把 alternate_names 改成 None, 也不要删掉这个键。字段为空时必须得到 [], 以保持文档结构不变。
procedure: 定位 openlibrary/plugins/upstream/addbook.py 中处理表单输入的 page 类 (例如 author_edit.process_input)。找到把自由文本字段规范化为列表的代码, 典型写法是 `x.replace('\n', ';').split(';')`。
确认空项的来源。以下几种输入都会在 split 后产生空字符串或纯空白字符串: 结尾分号、连续分隔符 (;; 或空行)、整个字段为空 (''.split(';') == [''])。
复用已有的 list comprehension, 不要另写辅助函数。在其中加上与已有 strip 一致的守卫条件: `[name.strip() for name in raw.replace('\n', ';').split(';') if name.strip()]`。
保留上游的 None 兜底 `author.get('alternate_names', None) or ''`, 这样 split 不会在 None 上报错。
顺手检查同文件中其他由分隔符拼成的列表字段 (如 links、subjects、identifiers), 看是否有同样的空项问题。只有当缺陷确实相同时, 才用同一种守卫修复。
validation: 运行现有测试: pytest openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests
保存作者编辑页面, 字段留空和带结尾分号各试一次, 确认保存后的文档中没有空字符串名称。

name: filter-empty-toc-rows-at-parse-and-read
negative_constraints: Do not fix only the parser. Existing stored documents already contain empty rows, so the read path must filter them too.
Do not keep two copies of the legacy-string/dict normalization logic in get_toc_text and get_table_of_contents.
Do not filter on line.strip() alone. Lines containing only the ' | ' separators must be treated as empty.
Do not drop rows that have only a level, label or page number. Filter only when all normalized fields are empty or zero.
Do not change the stored TOC schema (level/label/title/pagenum) or the text format produced by get_toc_text.
procedure: Locate the TOC handling in openlibrary/plugins/upstream/models.py: Edition.get_toc_text, Edition.get_table_of_contents and Edition.set_toc_text. Then locate parse_toc and parse_toc_row in openlibrary/plugins/upstream/utils.py.

Write-side fix: in parse_toc, change the line filter so that a line made only of whitespace and '|' separators counts as empty. Use line.strip(' |') instead of line.strip(). An edit-form line such as ' |  | ' then never becomes a stored TOC entry.

Read-side fix: make get_table_of_contents the single normalizer. It converts each stored row into web.storage(level, label, title, pagenum). That includes legacy rows stored as plain strings, which become level=0 with title=r. Default level with safeint(r.get('level','0'), 0).
After normalizing, drop rows where every field is falsy: [row for row in d if any(row.values())]. This cleans empty rows that are already in the database.
Refactor get_toc_text so it iterates over self.get_table_of_contents() and only formats each row: '*' * r.level + ' ' + ' | '.join([r.label, r.title, r.pagenum]).
Remove the duplicated basestring/dict branching from get_toc_text, so normalization lives in one place.
validation: Run the existing tests for openlibrary/plugins/upstream (test_utils, test_models).
Call parse_toc with input containing ' |  | ', blank lines and valid rows. Check that only the valid rows are returned.

Build an Edition with table_of_contents that mixes legacy strings, dict rows and empty dict rows. Check that get_table_of_contents omits the empty rows and that get_toc_text produces no blank ' |  | ' lines.
Check that a set_toc_text(get_toc_text()) round-trip is stable.

name: filter-then-aggregate-with-empty-check-pattern
negative_constraints: 不要依赖 max(..., default=...) 引入一个哨兵值后再参与比较, 除非能确认该哨兵不会被写进结果字段。
不要把修复扩大为重写整个解析函数。保持最小 diff, 一次 bugfix 只改出问题的聚合点。
procedure: 在 MARC 解析代码中搜索 max(... for ... if ...) 或 min(... for ... if ...) 这种带过滤条件的生成器聚合写法。
判断过滤条件是否可能把所有元素都排除掉。来自外部编目数据的字段内容不可信, 应默认会出现这种情况。
改写为三步: 先过滤成列表, 再判空并 continue 或跳过, 最后聚合。
跳过的粒度保持在当前子字段或当前值, 与原循环结构一致。
validation: 运行 repository 已有的测试套件。
对每个修改过的聚合点, 至少用一条会让过滤结果为空的输入验证: 不抛异常, 且输出中不包含该字段。

name: fix-compiled-regex-sub-argument-order-in-marc-normalizers
negative_constraints: 不要只补一个参数就算修复。证据 diff 写的是 sub(m.group(1), ''),它让匹配到的 ISBN 成了替换内容、空串成了输入,结果恒为 '',bug 依然存在。参数顺序必须是 (repl='', string=m.group(1))。
不要把 re.sub(pattern, repl, string) 模块级函数的签名和已编译 pattern.sub(repl, string) 的签名混用。
不要改变 normalize_isbn 的 None 返回语义,也不要改它在 procedures 表中的注册方式,调用方依赖这些行为。
不要顺手改动 re_isbn_chars 的捕获组编号。m.group(1) 依赖第一个捕获组。
procedure: 定位 catalog/marc/parse.py 中的 normalize_isbn,以及同文件里其它 procedures[...] 注册的 clean_*/normalize_* 函数。
检查每个已编译正则的 .sub 调用。Python 的签名是 pattern.sub(repl, string, count=0),替换内容在前,被处理的字符串在后。
normalize_isbn 的正确写法是:先用 m = re_isbn_chars.search(s) 找到 ISBN 片段,再执行 return re_not_isbn_chars.sub('', m.group(1)),把非 ISBN 字符替换为空。
复用文件内已有的 re_isbn_chars / re_not_isbn_chars 正则,不要新建一套重复的正则。
保留原有的返回约定:匹配不到时 return None;匹配到时返回只含 ISBN 字符的字符串。
改完后在 REPL 中手动验证几种输入:'0-306-40615-2 (pbk.)'、'ISBN 9780306406157'、'123456789X',以及完全没有 ISBN 的字符串。
validation: 如有现有测试就运行,例如 catalog/marc 下的测试。
用 python -c 导入 catalog.marc.parse,断言 normalize_isbn('0-306-40615-2') == '0306406152'。
断言返回值非空,防止出现 sub 参数颠倒导致恒返回 '' 的回归。
断言对不含 ISBN 的输入返回 None。

name: fix-misnamed-dict-method-in-followup-commit
negative_constraints: Do not replace the call with a try/except or a getattr hack to hide the AttributeError. Use the correct method name.
Do not change the default value or the key names. In this case, keep author_key and author_name with a default of [].
Do not use the follow-up typo fix to refactor or reformat unrelated code, including trailing whitespace.
Do not rename set_default calls that belong to custom classes which really define that method. Check the receiver type first.
procedure: Locate the lines touched by the previous commit with git show HEAD~1 or git log -p on the target file, e.g. openlibrary/plugins/worksearch/search.py.
Look for method names that do not exist on the receiver type. For example, set_default does not exist on dict or web.storage; the correct name is setdefault.
Rename the call to the real stdlib API. Keep the arguments and the default values unchanged, for example w.setdefault('author_key', []).
Grep the whole repository for the same misspelling (git grep -n 'set_default'), and fix every case where the receiver is a dict or a storage object.
Keep the diff minimal. Change only the misspelled identifier, and do not touch nearby logic such as the authors zip built from author_key and author_name.
